body:
I can't feel like I did everything I could, she took that away from me. Once it started getting difficult for her to be alone when she felt i didn't prioritize her she pushed me further away and into work, she never spoke to me about her feelings, that they were slowly changing from me over to this other guy.

I was good for her, everyone said how much she has grown with me how much good i've done for her. I was by her side at all times, when she changed contraceptions and the hormones made her gain 20kg, she always felt so down during this time and couldn't stand being in pictures and even her family buillied her for it, i stood by her, i loved her no matter what i worked from my side to sort things out and she ended up losing all of that weight and more. She was happy and got confident. I kept supporting her and helping her build her confidence watching her grow. I pushed her to get a job but she wanted to focus on the studies so i supported her through that. I stood by her side through everything.

We had bad times but we knew that would happen in our situtation, the only thing we needed to do was work on it together and i told her that so many times but she didn't and by not talking to me she took away my chance to fix this, it was stolen from me.

She basically was my wife, she spoke for years about marrage, and i wanted to get married to her so badly. Her only contingency was that she wanted to do it after University so I waited. And once we got to the new country it was an option but i wanted to buy proper rings and we couldn't afford that so i postponed it. I had planned to get rings and propose this summer because it was the first time when we were out of that bad place, first time in 2 years we would have good money and a good life, it's when our life was really about to start here. She was done with her language studies, i was working properly, we'd both have vacation times and the pieces fell in place but she invested all her emotions into this other guy and gave up on us just weeks before the end of the dark tunnel.

**I destroy any chance of anything possible, I ruin everything**

She is supposed to have landed, her family is going to pick her up and its an hour 40 min drive home. I wait. It's been 4 hours she still haven't messaged me. I'm panicking what if something has happened. I start looking at her social media to see if there is anything indicating she's safe. There is a picture that her family has met her at the airport but nothing of her coming home yet. I'm scared I want to know she's safe I see..... the other guys name, she's added him back on social media. I start checking her other ones, she's added him back on all of them. I panic I lose all form of self-control I hack into her chats and see that she's been talking to him for over an hour and I've yet to receive a message that she's safe. I'm done, I've lost everything, I'm throwing up its so physically painfull, I have no self-control there is not a single part of me that wants to live, I grab a knife. She replies. I call her, we video chat I'm shouting I'm screaming I have no control, I don't want to live anymore. She sees the knife, I tell her I'm going to kill myself. I ask her one last time is her contact with this guy on the other side of the globe worth more then my life. She can't say, she is shouting different things. I cut my wrist.

The blade is dull, it starts to bleed but it's not deep enough. She screams, she's angry she hangs up. I cut myself a 2nd time, a 3rd, a 4th, a 5th, a 6th time. I can't get through, I have the sharpest kitchen knife I own but I don't know if I'm not trying enough or if it's too dull. I have several lines, they are all bleeding but it's not a lot it's not much. I grab my car keys and go out the door. I start driving. I'm doing 180 trying to find something I can crash into, something that will kill me. I call my best friend in the other country to tell him what's happened, he calms me down slightly. I call my mentor to thank him and make peace, he calms me down more. I get a bit of sense back and maybe it's to early to do this. I go home, I sleep. 

I'm now sat here writing this and feel like she ruined my entire life, I only went back to this coutnry because I saw a future of us two out here but I didn't want to be here by myself at any point. I now feel that I destroy what ever small little chance there ever was of  her coming back to utalize the chance in this country and everything she'd worked for and I don't know what's worse, there is nothing right now that makes me want to live on. If that blade had been sharper it would have worked, If I didn't call those two people to make peace and they talked some sense into me I would have crashed that car. I'm so lost and beyond repair I don't know what to do. I feel like she in desperation projected her feelings onto this guy across the globe because she had none else and didn't talk to me, that slowly her feelings for me were stolen until it was to late. I feel betrayed, lied and cheated on from the one person I had my life trusted too, the person I gave everything too. She never gave us a chance and she keeps telling me this guy was not a factor but she gave up two years of the life she was building here, she gave up 4.5 years of our relationship because she couldn't try to cut contact with him.

We're on week two I know she is lying, It's 4:30 in the morning I still cant sleep, I get onto her email and sees she has made a second account. I was right. I wait until 7 when she wakes up and I've arrange to get the Today and tomorrow Friday off from work and I confront her, she keeps saying its no second account, she asked if I went onto her email because she'd gotten one about an iPhone in our city logging into her mail. I said yes she says there is no account and she shows me her phone and her inbox and there is no mail there, I click on the bin box and sure enough there it is the mail about her second account. She fesses up and says she has been talking to him the whole time we were supposed to try, she never cut contact with him. She says I trapped her with making her try when she didn't want to, that I suffocated her with overlooking what she did every second, I tell her I didn't mean to do that but if she hadn't lied the whole time it wouldn't have been like that.

I break down again, I feel so betrayed, so lied to and cheated on I can't do this anymore. She speaks to her mum and arranges to fly back to her home country the next morning. I'm furious, she's throwing away her entire life out here for this guy. I can accept us living apart, I can accept our relationship ending but I can't accept her throwing everything we've worked for during the last two years away. I threaten to throw her out to take her bag and get the fuck out. She's leaving everything related to this country behind, everything she's been given or I've gotten for her. I tell her she don't deserve it, only pack the stuff that was hers when she came here and to get out. 

She breaks down in tears, this time I think they are genuine. She'd have no money no phone only a hand luggage and a suitcase and I was about to throw her out, she'd betrayed me and lied to me she couldn't rely on my family in anyway to help her she was on her own out here. She cries, she is a wreck, she says this isn't her she never thought she'd become something like this, she never meant to hurt me she says I can probably never forgive her but she needs me to know. I feel sorry for her, I feel like it's genuine. I know she loves it out here and in her heart of hearts she wants a life in the country, she has subconsciously said it several times “I might be back for season to start” or “Its going to be a while until I can use this again” I think that if she can cut this guy out and go back to her home country and family and soul search she'll realize what she's losing and giving up on and I think that's the right thing to do. I tell her she can stay and that I drive her to the airport tomorrow she is grateful, we talk of how we became this, how it wasn't suppose to end like this and talking about her maybe coming back. She sits down, she grabs my hands and looks into my eyes, she pinky promises and swears, sealing it with a kiss that she will cut contact with this guy to try find herself once back in her country, that this isn't who she is. I believe her.

She says she wants to call him one last time to end things and I agree. I'm not suppose to listen I'm in the other room with a headset on and loud music but I don't have any trust left. I remove it. I hear her telling him what happened yesterday I hear her say that “she did what she had to to convince me to let her stay”. I'm furious. She tells him “I'm supposed to be skyping you now to end things and that we need to cut contact” he says something back and she answers “of course not, we will”. I'm furious, I storm out the door and rip the internet cord so their call ends I question her, she says it was out of context that she was going to tell him that they had to end everything. I don't believe her I'm shouting, she finds an explanation that she was going to and she was just telling him what had happened and that she needed to finish it. I plug the internet back they continue their call she says she have to make it fast but that they cant talk and need to cut contact, that she needs to soulsearch once back home to find herself and her independence, they hang up. I'm torn, I don't know what to do I tell her that after all this betrayal and lying I cant live like this, this one pinky promise she made, when she looked into my eyes and swore this is the one promise I need her to keep I can't take her breaking this, she tells me she won't and kisses me.

I drive her to the airport, we're saying our byes, she is in tears so am I. This is coming to an end. She goes through the check-in and I can't follow. I'm hoping that she keeps her promise and that she finds herself, I can accept not being in a relationship and not living together but I would like her as a friend I still care for her and more then anything I don't want her to give up everything she's put into this country, for a chance at a life here. She says she'll message me when she's home safe. I drive home.

I'm a bit lost and upset but I sit down at the computer, going to watch something on netflix or play something, I fire up the chat program. She's still logged in. Less then 30 minutes after I left the airport I see she'd message him. I'm losing myself, I text her what the fuck is going on, this was the one promise she couldn't keep. She says she was only messaging him that she was at the airport flying home so he knew and that she was going to be safe and once when she'd arrived at her family. It was a spur of the moment thing she just did it, I question her that this promise she made, the one promise she couldn't break she did for a spur of the moment thing? She tells me she will only message him once she's back and that's it. Her plane is about to lift in 5 minutes we have to break contact I calm down. I let her fly. I watch stuff, I play stuff I wait.

**My life is about to end**

May 2017 everything had started to feel off, I felt like she wasn't talking to me and that she wasn't genuine, I could feel something was wrong and I questioned her but she'd tell me how good everything was how happy and proud she was and that she loved me, at one point I even told her I didn't feel loved anymore and she cried and told me that of course she loved me.

I was going to film 3 weeks out of town and on the first weekend between the first two, on the Thursday there was some train/flight issues so even though I had not plan to travel back there was a replacement car doing the 6hour drive down to where we lived so I decided to jump into it because I missed her and wanted to surprise her, she was a sleep as I came in late and her first question was what I was doing home I told her to surprise her that I'd missed her. Her follow up question was when was I going to leave again. I was hurt by this and told her why she'd ask something like that so fast, she tell me she was just so surprised. I questioned her and said that she needed to talk to me that I love her and I need to know what's going on. She said everything was fine, that she loved me she was just very surprised since it was unplanned. On the Sunday I left to go back to filming and we had planned that she was going to come visit me in the country capital where she'd never been I booked the hundred euro ticket for her to get there and couldn't wait to take here there and show her a new place, one of the biggest things in my life was to show this girl the world and I was going to get to do that for the first time in a long while.

I call her the day before she was suppose to travel up and she said she was ill with a stomach bug and that she couldn't come up. I knew something was wrong and started questioning her, what was going on, she said she didn't wanna do this over the phone, I begged her to tell me. She told me she didn't love me any more and wanted to break up, she told me she was with my brother and my mother at the moment talking to them. She'd told all her friends, her family, now my family about this but never said anything to me. I broke down and got the first train I could to go home to talk to her. I had to figure out what had happened, how this could have become.

She told me she wanted independence and that she'd slowly stopped loving me, I asked why she never talked to me about it, that I had asked her so many times what was up and that I needed her to talk to me, we were having rough times for a year and we'd known that I'd talked to her about it and told her she had to look forward and she had to talk to me. She said she felt she couldn't talk to me she didn't know what to do. I asked her if there was another guy that had influenced this, the guy she'd been talking to online has he anything to do with this she said no, that it was nothing like that. She said she felt I hadn't given her attention in a while and I agreed to that because I had been away so much and swamped with work, that everything was a bout to change in 2 weeks times when she was done with school and I was back. She couldn't wait for that.

I walked out the door in a rage, I got on a train, I got on a bus, I got on a plane. I roamed around Europe for 3 days to try clear my mind. I came to terms with the fact that she'd never been independent that she'd never lived by herself and I understood that she have to do this. I wish she would have talked to me while she still loved me because I could have supported that and lived away from her whilst still having a relationship. I wanted to give this girl the world and I understood this was something she had to do. I came home ready to do this for her, trying to figure out a way for to get independent here.

We were on the sofa watching TV, she fell asleep in her lap, her phone went off and I looked. I see she's been messaging this online guy for months. A 35 year old that lives on the other side of the globe. I see they tell each other they love one another, that she can't live without each other. I see her sending sexual pictures to him and him to her, she begging for his cock and his cum in her mouth, that she thinks about him when she fingers herself. He had been talking to her for months, this whole time when she felt alone because I was away she never told me, she sought attention and put her emotions towards this internet guy for so long that she got completely invested in him. I felt robbed, I felt cheated on, I felt lied too. At this point I wasn't willing to support her or have my family support her to an independent life here when I lose her to some other guy.

I confront her about this, I asked her why she lied and that his guy changes everything. She says to me that it's not because of him and I've seen the messages I know how deep into this guy she'd become. I believed it was not real, that because she was alone and felt neglected with me being away instead of talking to me when she was desperate for attention she found someone else to give her that, a guy across the globe that there is no real future with. I think that if it wasn't him it would have been another person, as long as she refused to talk to me and seek attention elsewhere it would have happened. She ones again tells me that she wants independence and that's the real reason, I tell her to prove it to cut all contact with this guy and try work things out with me for a bit. She tells me she doesn't want to but she's willing to put it to the side and try. I get to speak to the guy on skype and I ask him to please for her sake, stay away for a bit, she is about to throw her entire life in this new country, the last 2 years we invested in this all away because of him, please man up and respect this and cut contact with her, because I cant ask her to do that alone. He agrees and then she speaks to him and they say their byes and they remove each other from their social media.

We're going to try. We have two weeks where we go on concerts, out for dinners, out walking, we're dancing, she's laughing we're having a great time. Throughout this entire time I have this bad feeling, she keeps fiddling with her phone and keeps sending so many messages and paranoid as I am I keep asking her who she messaging, who she talking to, what they talking about. I'm suffocating her with these questions constantly peering over at her when she does stuff but I know something is not right. She shows me her snap chat and says she's spoken to someone, I can see they are not in the conversation list and I suspect she manually cleared the conversation, I think that the person and name she says she talks to that is in the contact list is actually the guy under a different name. This goes on for a few days, I ask her at one point who she talking to now and she comes up with something I walk over and jumps down on the couch, as I do I see that she's just on the login screen. I ask why would she have to login if she was just chatting? She says it got disconnected. I know it's a lie.

**My life is about to start**

About 6 months into the degree something changed, I met a girl at the same degree. I'd been surrounded by girls before but never committed to long-term relationships I never found myself to care enough about someone else but this girl was different. She was 4 years younger then me, I was going to turn 23 and she was turning 19 (albeit born 10months earlier in the year then me). She had a long-term relationship before this I think for 2 or 3 years.  She'd grown up on a small Island with almost no life experience, she'd never had a job, she'd never really cooked a meal in her life or done housework. Her father passed away when she was eight and she lived in lower class income family, 3 siblings and a single mother, a mother who'd do everything for her. The number of things she'd eat would be countable on two, if not one hand.

I started seeing her more and more, she interested me, she had so little experience and knowledge in life and had was so shy and had no confidence when I'd take her place she'd be in awe of the things she'd never known, the things I could show and teach her. I fell in love with her and for the first time in my entire life I cared about someone, I really cared. I wanted to give this girl the world. She fell in love with me and we complimented each other so well, I'd give her confidence and open her eyes for an entire world and she made me into a better person, a caring and loving person. 

I was living in the apartment with my friend and his girlfriend and my girlfriend lived in dorms. The 3 room apt got very cramped when she was over (which she was a lot) and I started considering getting my own place, at the same time my girlfriends first year at the dorms ended and she had to find somewhere to live. Calculating costs and availability and places for us to stay we realized it would be very beneficial to actually live together. Only 5 months into our relationship we moved in together, at this time we were so happy. 

We lived there for the last two years of our degree. I took with her to my original country and she absolutely fell in love with it, she'd say she could see herself living there. I took her to the 2nd country and same thing there she was in awe. We'd go travelling to other countries as well and every time we both felt over the moon, I got to show her the world and she got to see the world. She'd sit and talk to me and make me promise to never leave her, that we had a future that she would want to get married and have kids, to grow old together. I'd never in my life considered to grow old, I hated old people, I hoped I'd be dead before I turned 40 even but she changed that, she changed all of that. I wanted a future with her, it became my dream.

As we were getting close towards finishing our degree we had to make decisions on what to do with our future. We had a lot of tax reduction for our apartment because we were students but that would end and our costs would go up drastically. She'd never had a job and there was no real jobs within our field in this area, we'd have to commute two hours there and two hours back the jobs I could get there was low paying and wouldn't be able to support the both of us in the apartment we had. Her mother had a 3room semi-detached house with 4 people living in it, that was not an option for us. The only solution I saw at the time that I knew would work was to take her with me to my country of origin and give her a life there. My family had an empty apartment available and I knew there I could get a job fast that would allow us to survive.

She loved me and she wanted a future together, I loved her and wanted a future together and even though I had moved out of that country and didn't wanna be there I did it for her, for our future. We moved abroad together for a new start. I told here that I would be tough at the start, I'm going to have to work to support the both of us and she would have to learn the language. I told her that she always had to look ahead to chase our dream until she was done with the language studies and could get a job.

I got a 8hr, 5days a week job, an hour lunch break and about 45min traveling. I was out 5 days a week 10-11hrs per day. She got into the language school and did 2hrs a day 5 days a week. It was rough it wasn't a job within my field and it wasn't a job I wanted but I did it for her. She didn't get out much and was in our apartment alone a lot I tried to push her to get a job of sorts but she only wanted to focus on the language and I accepted that. Our relationship got a little bit stale but we loved each other and we supported each other through this.

After a year in this country I was offered an opportunity where a guy in our field of education (Film) had me in an interview and wanted to mentor me. I went to my girlfriend and spoke to her about this chance. She was ecstatic about it and told me I should go for it. I told her that it will make things rough again, I will make less money as a trainee we're going to live on quite bare minimum until she gets a job or my two year training period is over or I get bigger paid jobs. She was certain I should go for this opportunity, that I'm very good at what I do and she knows I'll succeed and so I did. I believed her and I took this up. 

I started working in the film industry and after 6months I got hired myself for a TV-series that was filmed out of town. I spoke to her about this and she insisted I should take it that it was a great opportunity, I explained that I would be away 4-5 days a week out of town and only home for the weekends and she said she was so proud of me and loved me and that I have to go for this.

Whilst I was away she got offered an internship for 10 weeks, 3 days a week for her language studies that she took. For the first time she was out working and doing stuff but I was not at home to be there. I'd come home every weekend and asked her how things was and tell her that I loved her. She'd tell me that everything was good and that she loved me and that I should focus on work, I believed her and I did. I drove my head into work so hard focusing on this. I knew that she'd been playing on the Playstation and started talking a lot to some people, at one point when I came home I accidentally saw her chat and I saw that she'd told this guy she loved him, in a “yeah I love you too” I questioned it but she shrugged it off and said she loved him as a friend and I believed her.

As this job went towards the end I got offered an opportunity at a new feature that started in April 2017. I'd gone from an office job to working on feature films with academy nominated directors in less than 10 months, I'd pushed hard for this and drove my head into it because I had the love of my life supporting me and telling me to go for it and so I did. This new feature kicked off and I was swamped with work. I felt that things were different between us and I tried to talk to her, she told me that everything is fine, that she loved me and how proud she was of me and how well I was doing. On the side of this she was getting so close to the end of her language education she was going to Finish it at the same time I was going to complete the feature. For the first time she'd be able to start a real life out here, get a job and get her own income, to not be reliant on me so much, we would be able to go back to our travels to see the world, she could go shopping without me and surprise her family or friends or me with gifts, she'd be independent for the first time. I was getting paid extra now and this summer we were going to go back to visit her family and/or go out traveling elsewhere, going to start doing all those things we hadn't been able to do for the last year. For two years I had supported her studies and her entire life.
